name: edit-transaction-multi-file
note: One file_apply call rewrites an import, renames a module and adds a note. It proves the transaction covers several paths and several operation kinds at once, and that the receipt reports every path the call really changed — including the source of a move, whose path never appears as a written file.
prompt: move legacy.py to helpers.py and update the caller

verify.command: test -f helpers.py && test -f NOTES.md && test ! -e legacy.py && grep -q 'helpers.legacy' api.py
